scope: Controlled original synthetic media, actual production service/HTTP/native proof/client/engine in sandboxed Electron renderer; silent pre-destination capture, no physical listening claim.

cases.name: controlled-25s
cases.alignment: Observed production AudioBufferSource.start absolute sample origin; no content-derived offset or tolerance-based search.
cases.note: Additional test capture is bounded separately. AudioWorklet emits silence downstream; no physical-output or listening claim.

backend.allocationNote: Production protocol admission is fixed96MiB; renderer reports actual retained mixed-buffer copies. Backend telemetry reports per-block PCM and active cursor count; this is not process RSS.
backend.workNote: workFrames is measured conservative session debit, including original-segment seek prefixes and bounded read-ahead. measuredHashBytes/workFrames report the largest session within a case, not an RSS measurement or the sum of repeated performance sessions.
